description: Open source inference engine optimized for consumer hardware. Profiles your machine, recommends the best models for it, then downloads, tunes, and runs them. Works on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, or nothing but a CPU.
summary: Open source local inference engine. It runs models on the hardware you already have, whether that's a Mac, an NVIDIA or AMD GPU, or just a CPU. Plug it into Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Oh My Pi, and Cline.
